people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Millo
people.line: A fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon

translations.web: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
translations.bsb: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
translations.kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
